title: Q9
description:
“Tempted as we are, yet without sin.”
Read: Exo 16–17, Num 14, Deut 8:2–3, Mat 4:1–11
a) Israel failed its wilderness tests of hunger, thirst and trust. Jesus answered His own tests with words from Deuteronomy. What does Israel's failure bring forward about what His “without sin” means?
